newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan tenders to buy Jul 16-30 unleaded reformate.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan tenders to buy Jul 16-30 unleaded reformate.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has issued a tender to buy July 16-30 arrival unleaded 95-octane reformate, a company official said on Wednesday.
The tender which seeks 250,000-barrel cargoes to the ports of Keelung or Taichung, closes June 4 and is valid for two days.
In its last tender, CPC bought two cargoes of unleaded reformate at $25.20 per barrel, cost-and-freight Taiwan for the June 21-30 arrival cargo and $24.92 for July 1-15 delivery.
